turns.tutor:
Questions with did talk about the past, so first let us check how a regular verb shows the past.
Look: today I walk to school. Yesterday I walked to school.
Rule: Add -ed to a regular verb to talk about a finished action in the past.
Right: She cooked rice yesterday. Wrong: She cook rice yesterday.
Now you try. Write this for yesterday: "I clean my room today."
